description: React component for editing scheduled posts in Mattermost, including handling user input, emoji and GIF insertion, markdown formatting, and modal interactions.

classes.name: EditPost
classes.description: React component for editing scheduled or regular posts with rich input handling, emoji/GIF support, and markdown formatting.

methods.name: handleEdit
methods.description: Handles saving the edited post, including running hooks, validation, and modal interactions.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Cancels editing and refocuses the input.

methods.name: handleEditScheduledPost
methods.description: Handles updating a scheduled post, including validation and modal interactions.

methods.name: handleEditKeyPress
methods.description: Handles key press events for submitting or hotkeys during editing.

methods.name: handleKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events for shortcuts like markdown, escape, and line breaks.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates state when the input text changes.

methods.name: handlePaste
methods.description: Processes pasted content, including HTML links and code blocks.

methods.name: applyHotkeyMarkdown
methods.description: Applies markdown formatting based on hotkeys.

methods.name: handleRefocusAndExit
methods.description: Refocuses a specified element and exits editing mode.

methods.name: handleAutomatedRefocusAndExit
methods.description: Clears message and refocuses input after save or cancel.
